thread:
ana: quick pitch 
Hey Marketing crew : micro-launch idea called 'Garden Labs' -> 3 tiny tutorials + one reference demo + a 45m webinar. goal: fast community wins and reusable assets for a longer launch post. :seedling:
sam: solid. keep everything under one repo but with clear lesson folders and an easy "run this" demo. starter issues for contributors.
jordan: benchmarks should be small reproducible scripts w/ config snippet. include p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens. short YAML sample is fine.
li: visuals: hero image, 2 GIFs (app walkthrough + bench run), and social cards. i'll mock tomorrow.
marta: happy to recruit an external maintainer for the webinar panel. also can help seed contributor PRs.
nana: landing page: capture email + hidden param `cohort=garden-labs` so we can route leads to community queue. Sam, can you set UTM pattern?
sam: yea use `?utm_source=gardenlabs&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=garden_launch`. ops will wire redirect.
launch-bot: Reminder: add checklist to #marketing-launches with due dates.
jordan: measurement: publish a short benchmark table + raw CSV link. include a brief "how we measured" section.
nana: messaging: developer-first headline, then a separate blurb for enterprise/dedicated follow-up.
li: outreach channels: X, LinkedIn, community newsletters, and OSS forums. teaser clips for day-of.
sam: timeline: scaffold + issues (Mon), community sprint (Tue-Wed), finalize posts + bench (Thu), webinar + launch post (Fri). compact but doable.
marta: action items acked. I'll line up an external panelist and seed PRs.
nana: great. i'll draft the launch brief and drop in #marketing-launches. :rocket:
